post.summary: Manually triggers a historical backfill for a specific tenant within a given date range.
post.description:
If StartDate or EndDate are omitted, the system defaults to a 2-year lookback ending now.
This job is offloaded to Hangfire for background processing.
Validation is handled automatically by the ValidationFilter.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant for which to backfill data.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date for the backfill operation. If null, the DefaultLookBackPeriodYears is used to calculate the start date.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end date for the backfill operation. If null, the current time is used.

202.description: If the job was successfully enqueued.

404.description: If the tenant was not found.

409.description: If a fetch job is already running for this tenant.
